bull.t: Strong Revenue Growth and Infrastructure Scale
bull.b: Rapid revenue growth alongside a tenfold increase in data throughput indicates strong customer adoption and operating scale. Continued expansion of traffic, requests and IP coverage can strengthen platform relevance and support durable growth.

A debt-free balance sheet and substantial liquidity provide flexibility to fund infrastructure, product development and compliance needs. This reduces refinancing risk and gives Alarum greater capacity to absorb volatility while pursuing expansion.

Broadening beyond proxy services into AI-ready data and enterprise workflows could diversify revenue and raise strategic value. Positive EBITDA growth suggests scale benefits are emerging, supporting reinvestment and longer-term operating leverage.

bear.b: Parallel proceedings create potentially prolonged legal, compliance and management burdens, while allegations concerning disclosures may affect customer and stakeholder trust. Although outcomes are uncertain, the exposure represents a durable governance risk.

bear.t: Proxy Network Disruption and Compliance Risk
bear.b: Service interruptions and law-enforcement scrutiny threaten continuity in a core business area and may require costly controls, remediation and customer support. Extended disruption could weaken retention, revenue visibility and the economics of the network.

bear.t: Margin Compression and Unstable Cash Generation
bear.b: Negative recent cash flow and lower gross margin weaken earnings quality and reduce funding comfort. Higher R&D and payroll spending may support growth, but profitability must stabilize for scale to translate into durable cash generation.
